capabilities: Copy or export notes as portable Markdown with configurable transforms (wikilinks, embeds, callouts, frontmatter, attachments)
Send notes to and import from Bear, Youdao Note, Yinxiang, and WPS Cloud Note via CLIs, URL schemes, or APIs
Push notes to Flomo, WeKnora, IMA, and Octop via their MCP servers or REST APIs
Pick a target notebook, folder, or knowledge base from a shared fuzzy-search list
Enable and configure each provider independently in settings and via right-click context menu commands
disambiguation: Not a general file-format converter; it copies notes as portable Markdown and targets a fixed, curated set of named apps rather than any import format.
extras: Not in the official community catalogue; installed via BRAT or GitHub releases. README discloses shell subprocess use, filesystem access outside the vault, and an Ajv dynamic-code-execution notice; Octop credentials may sync with the vault.
motivation: "most people who care about Markdown portability use more than one of these apps" and bundling them avoids duplicating the transform layer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert its syntax into portable Markdown for other apps or to push and pull notes with external note services.

requires.name: Bear, WPS Cloud Note, Youdao Note, Flomo, Yinxiang, WeKnora, IMA, or Octop
API keys or tokens for Youdao, Flomo, Yinxiang, WeKnora, IMA
Username and password for self-hosted Octop

summary: Exports notes as portable Markdown and sends or imports them between the vault and Bear, Youdao, WPS Cloud Note, Flomo, Yinxiang, and other apps.
